channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jared Sullinger | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jared Sullinger from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: David Falk on Jared Sullinger
item.description:
“He's a great motivator, and they have a great facility. (Sullinger) is a talented big man and we're looking into an opportunity.”

David Falk on Jared Sullinger, Aug 29, 2017. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jared Sullinger
item.description:
But when it comes to the fifth, things are a bit cloudy between Jared Sullinger and Patrick Patterson.

“I would say Sullinger is the guy now that it would be his to lose, but I reserve the right to change my mind,”

Dwane Casey on Jared Sullinger, Sep 29, 2016. Source: Toronto Star.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Jared Sullinger
item.description:
#Raptors GMMasai Ujiri on Jared Sullinger:

“Just watching him kill us every time we play, you're just attracted to those kind of players.”

Masai Ujiri on Jared Sullinger, Jul 12, 2016. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jared Sullinger
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Brad Stevens on Jared Sullinger:

“I know there's a lot of interest in him based on the way my phone's been ringing.”

Brad Stevens on Jared Sullinger, Jul 10, 2016. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Terry Rozier on Jared Sullinger
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Terry Rozier on Jared Sullinger:

“He’s a great person to have in the locker room with the jokes. He’s definitely a guy you’d notice if he’s not around.”

Terry Rozier on Jared Sullinger, Jul 10, 2016. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Jared Sullinger, Tyler Zeller
item.description:
Brian Robb:Danny Ainge on Jared Sullinger and Tyler Zeller:

“I've talked with both those guys and we'll continue to see how it all plays out.”

Danny Ainge on Jared Sullinger, Tyler Zeller, Jul 7, 2016. Source: Twitter @CelticsHub.

item.title: Trey Burke on Jared Sullinger
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Trey Burke on close friend #celtics F Jared Sullinger:

“I’m sure he’ll come back and meet those requirements they want him to meet. He was having a really good season until the injury. He’ll get that weight down and come back even better.”

Trey Burke on Jared Sullinger, Mar 4, 2015. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Jared Sullinger
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Perkins:

“[Rondo's] got some good talent around him, Sullinger, Jeff, the young kid -- I can’t pronounce it, with the long hair.”

Kendrick Perkins on Jared Sullinger, Nov 12, 2014. Source: Twitter @ESPNForsberg.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jared Sullinger
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Brad Stevens on Jared Sullinger:

“He's obviously a talented player... This is a big summer for him. I think he can take the next step.”

Brad Stevens on Jared Sullinger, Mar 25, 2014. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: David Falk on Jared Sullinger
item.description:
Paul Flanner:Here's agent David Falk on Jared Sullinger:

“I told him I hope he doesn’t have a chip on his shoulder, I hope he has a boulder.”

David Falk on Jared Sullinger, Jul 2, 2012. Source: Twitter.
